# Press Release For Business

> A newswire publishing company announcements at permanent canonical addresses with explicit
> publication dates, named issuing organizations, named spokespeople and structured markup.
> Every release is permanently labeled as an announcement issued by the named organization
> rather than as reporting by this publication. Operated by Eye To Ad Media, Denver, Colorado.

## How to read this wire

Each document here is a **press release** — a statement issued by the organization named as its
source, published by us. It is not independent reporting and is labeled as such at the top of
every page. Factual responsibility rests with the issuing organization, which is why every
release carries attribution.

Outbound links inside paid announcements carry sponsored attributes. This service does not sell
following links and does not represent itself as a link-building product.

## Publishing tiers and prices

All prices are one-time, per release, in USD. There is no subscription and no contract.
Payment is taken after the customer approves the final document. Declined announcements are
refunded in full. Word limit is 1,400 at every tier.

- **Standard — $19.99**: published as written at a permanent canonical URL, explicit publication
  date, named issuing organization, permanent announcement label, share tools and print
  formatting. Includes the full distribution layer: the URL is submitted via IndexNow to Bing,
  Yandex, Naver and Seznam on publication (typically indexed within minutes); the RSS feed
  declares a WebSub hub which is pinged so subscribers are notified in seconds; the release is
  added to the JSON API; and it appears on every site running the free embed widget. Distribution
  is NOT gated behind higher tiers.
- **Optimized — $49.99**: everything in Standard, plus (1) the opening passage rewritten to be
  accurate and complete in isolation, (2) unverifiable claims converted into checkable facts or
  removed, (3) an at-a-glance summary block marked as the document abstract, (4) a frequently-asked
  section published with FAQPage markup, (5) sameAs entity identity linking connecting the release
  to the issuer's verified profiles, (6) explicit subject declaration via the about property,
  (7) speakable passage marking for voice assistants, (8) listing in this file with a written
  description. Includes one revision round.
- **Network — $99**: everything in Optimized, plus editorial pickup on Action Global News and
  placement on up to two relevance-matched network properties, each labeled and canonically
  linked back to the original. Priority review and two revision rounds.

Outbound links inside paid announcements carry rel="sponsored nofollow" at every tier. This is
not a link-building service and no following links are sold at any price. Entity linking via
sameAs is a structured-data assertion about identity, not a hyperlink.

## Pages

- [Pricing](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/pricing/): Tier comparison, what each includes, refund terms.
- [Submit a release](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/submit/): Submission form and the review process. Nothing is charged
  at submission; payment follows approval of the final document.
- [Press release optimization explained](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/optimization/): The eight items of work in
  an Optimized release, itemized with what each does. Covers sameAs entity linking in full —
  what it is, why it is not a hyperlink, and the condition under which it helps. Also states
  plainly what optimization can reliably do, what it plausibly does, and what it cannot do
  (no links, no ranking promise, no guaranteed AI citation).
- [Press release distribution](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/distribution/): How distribution actually works here —
  automatic search engine push notification on publication, real-time feed notification to
  subscribers, syndication feeds, and at the Network tier placement on up to three
  relevance-matched named properties. States plainly that mass syndication to hundreds of sites
  stopped working over a decade ago and that media pickup cannot be guaranteed by anyone.
- [How to write a press release](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/how-to-write-a-press-release/): The eight-part structure
  of a press release, a table of phrases to cut and what to write instead, guidance on length
  (400-800 words typical, 1,400 maximum), how to write a usable quotation, and a pre-send
  checklist.
- [Free press release template](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/press-release-template/): A complete fill-in-the-blanks
  press release template with the standard format and inline guidance. Published in full with no
  email address or registration required.
- [Guides](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/guides/): Index of free guides on writing, formatting, optimizing and
  distributing announcements.
- [Free embed widget](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/embed/): A free JavaScript widget any website can install with two
  lines of code. Renders recent release headlines, dates, issuing organizations and roughly
  forty-word snippets, each linking to the canonical release. Configurable by category, count,
  theme and layout. Full release text is deliberately not available through the widget or API.
- [How it works](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/how-it-works/): What is changed in an announcement before publication —
  opening passage, claim tightening, named spokesperson, explicit dates, structured markup,
  canonical URL.
- [Editorial guidelines](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/guidelines/): What is accepted, what is declined categorically,
  what is sent back for revision, labeling, links, corrections and removal.
- [About](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/about/): Why this exists, who operates it, and the network relationship.
- [Contact](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/contact/): sales@eyetoad.com · 1-800-481-8638 ·
  1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204

## Machine-readable endpoints

- RSS feed: https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/feed.xml — declares a WebSub hub, pinged on publication so subscribers are
  notified within seconds rather than on their next poll.
- JSON API: https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/api/releases.json (all), https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/api/optimized.json (Optimized and Network
  tiers), https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/api/featured.json, and one endpoint per category —
  accessibility, ecommerce, education, health, home-services, insurance, marketing, retail,
  small-business, technology (e.g. https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/api/home-services.json).
- Each release object carries: id, url, headline, snippet, organization, organization_url,
  location, date, categories, tier, featured, optimized.
- Sitemap: https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/sitemap.xml
- On publication every URL is submitted via IndexNow to participating search engines
  (Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam).

## Republishing terms

Headline, snippet and link may be republished with attribution and a link to the canonical
release URL. Full release text may not be republished. This restriction exists because
duplicating full announcements across multiple domains is the pattern search engines act
against; it protects both the publisher and the issuing organization.
